name: Data Replication for Adjacent Macros
aliases: Ghost Zone Replication in Distributed Macros
definition: A data distribution strategy for adjacent macro groups where nodes replicate boundary voxels from neighbors to allow local resampling without inter-node fetches at data boundaries.
summary: Data Replication for Adjacent Macros eliminates inter-node communication by locally copying boundary voxels from neighboring nodes, a strategy distinct from non-adjacent distributions that require remote data fetching.
